source: Synthetic xenograft study; exponential hazards; seed 20260930; no measured biology

study.endpoint: Humane endpoint: tumor volume >= 2000 mm3 or body-weight loss > 20% (treated as the event)
study.censoring_rationale: Alive without endpoint at the day-60 study end, or death judged unrelated to tumor burden (one animal, day 33)
study.rationale: Ten mice randomized per arm; comparisons against vehicle declared before the study
